answer: Bind each identity to a distinct FIDO2 hardware security key: registration stores the key attestation, and one key backs one account, so a sybil farmer cannot spin up a thousand fakes from one laptop - each fake needs a real key bought, shipped and registered, pushing the cost off the ledge of free automation into real money per identity. The umber shadow is the trade-off: it is no haven for people without a key or who lose one, so key-loss recovery must be handled without reopening the fake-account door.
